title: System prompt path in Data
description: Resolve `MemorySmith:Chat:SystemPromptPath` relative to the active Data deployment root first, so single-folder deployments can relocate Data without breaking prompt discovery. Keep absolute path support and backward-compatible fallback resolution.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented in ChatServices prompt resolution: relative SystemPromptPath now resolves from the active Data deployment root first (derived from DataPath), then falls back to base-directory/current-directory behavior. Added regression test MemoryChatAgent_ResolvesRelativeSystemPromptPathFromDataRoot.
